respins.how_it_works:
If there is a Fortune symbol on the grid at the end of a Goddess Respin, it will activate any Flaming Frames after all wins have been collected. Activated Flaming Frames reveal Special symbols, which are either Bronze, Silver, or Gold Coin scatter symbols, and can also reveal Amphora scatter symbols, Green Shield, or Red Shield scatter symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x

 Silver Coins can have the following values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 After all Flaming Frames have been revealed, Shield symbols will activate. Green Shield symbols multiply Coins or Amphora symbols on adjacent squares with one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20. Red Shield symbols multiply all Coins or Amphora symbols on the grid with one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20.

 After all the Shield symbols have awarded their Multipliers, the Amphora symbols will activate. Amphora symbols collect the values of all Coins and other Amphora symbols on the grid and store their total value. Amphora symbols activate top to bottom, left to right.

wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 12 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the OMEN OF WAR bonus. In addition, a Fortune symbol is guaranteed on each spin! When Coins are revealed, they will always be Silver or Gold!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

modes.name: GODDESS RESPINS
modes.trigger: When a winning combination occurs, the symbols in that combination will be highlighted by a Flaming Frame and will trigger a Goddess Respin.
modes.effects:
When a winning combination occurs, the symbols in that combination will be highlighted by a Flaming Frame and will trigger a Goddess Respin. During a Respin, Flaming Frames, and the symbols within will stick to the grid. If a Fortune symbol is part of a Goddess Respin, the symbol will be highlighted by a Blue Flaming Frame. FS symbols that land together with a Sticky winning combination will also become Sticky without Flaming Frames.

 During the Goddess Respins, paying symbols that either create new winning combinations or extend existing ones will also become Sticky, and another Respin will be awarded. This continues until no further extensions are made or new winning combinations are created. When no new Respins are awarded, all wins will be paid out.

 Flaming Frames, Sticky Fortune symbols, and Sticky FS symbols are all removed at the start of the next spin. Sticky paying symbols are removed at the start of the next spin or when the Fortune Reveal feature activates.
